cands.name: Becky Carney
cands.bio: Democrat who has represented Mecklenburg County's District 102 in the NC House since 2003. Earlier she served three terms on the Mecklenburg Board of County Commissioners, starting in 1996. Sources list her occupation as homemaker or educational liaison. Charlotte resident.

endorsements.text: Sierra Club North Carolina (listed among 2026 endorsements and voter guide recommendations, along with two Sway voting groups: Accessibility Rights for ALL and Beyond The Ballot)

cands.gaps: We could not find Carney's birthplace, where she grew up, or when she moved to North Carolina. We found no documented deeds or stated positions from her on data centers, homestead property taxes, limits on investor or foreign land buying, growth and land conservation, immigration and H-1B, police pay and pensions, gun laws, abortion, or school choice and teacher pay. We found no statements from her on data centers or development. Her campaign site speaks generally of strengthening public schools, a living wage and sustainable communities, with no specific plans. Sources differ on her occupation (homemaker versus educational liaison), and we found no other career history. Her endorsement list comes only from Ballotpedia.

score.why: Raised $0, under $5,000 for this office: too little money to score fairly.

qual.background: About 23 years in the NC House (since 2003), after three terms on the Mecklenburg County Board of Commissioners (from 1996), where she helped establish the Education Budget Advisory Commission and served as education liaison to Charlotte-Mecklenburg Schools.
qual.why: Long legislative service plus prior local elected office puts her in the high band. Committee assignments and vice-chair posts were not counted. No law or formal budget career is documented.
